recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group intentionally decides to change the model and define search-result controls as formal SearchParameter resources, because that would be a new design decision rather than a missed application of FHIR-36879.
issue_request: FHIR-36879 was a Published FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking for missing definitions for search-result control parameters, general parameters such as _format and _pretty, and special parameters _query and _filter so CapabilityStatement searchParam declarations would not need unresolved canonicals.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied by commit 952e7fcef1, which added search.html text saying Search Result Parameters are not SearchParameter resources and do not appear in the registry. Related earlier FHIR-26430 work added missing common Resource SearchParameter definitions, and later FHIR-39335 work restored missed R5 common definitions including _filter.
additional_context: The Zulip thread behind the issue records the CapabilityStatement validation concern and Grahame's guidance that result parameters were not formally defined, so implementations should use the parameter code without a bogus definition. The HTTP page defines _format and _pretty as general RESTful parameters, and FHIR-I minutes mark FHIR-34332 as a duplicate of FHIR-36879 with an 18-0-1 Persuasive with Modification vote.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no source edit is needed. source/search.html already contains the no-SearchParameter/no-registry clarification for search-result parameters; source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml contains _query and _filter SearchParameter entries; and source/http.html documents _format and _pretty as HTTP controls.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue and Zulip-originated request that led to common Resource SearchParameter definitions; not separately decided here.
Package/tooling issue discussed alongside FHIR-26430 but focused on missing package-generated SearchParameters rather than this seed's clarification.
FHIR-I minutes explicitly mark it as duplicate of FHIR-36879.
Later Published R5 correction restored missing _has, _filter, and _in common search parameter definitions and supports the current-source state.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requesting definitions or clarification for search-result, HTTP/general, and special search-related parameters.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes the final seed scope: add appropriate definitions and explain why other parameters are not SearchParameter resources.

evidence_items.summary: The active search page states that Search Result Parameters are not search parameters, have no SearchParameter resources, and do not appear in the registry.
evidence_items.learned: The search-result-control portion of the requested clarification is already present in current source.

evidence_items.summary: The Resource search parameter bundle defines Resource-_query and Resource-_filter as special SearchParameter resources.
evidence_items.learned: The special parameters named by FHIR-36879 have formal definitions in current build-scope source.

evidence_items.summary: The HTTP page defines _format and _pretty as general parameters for all RESTful interactions; the search introduction links _format to the HTTP mechanism.
evidence_items.learned: The HTTP/general parameters are documented as HTTP controls rather than SearchParameter resources.

evidence_items.summary: Commit 'FHIR-36879 - Clarification of search result parameters.' added the current no-SearchParameter/no-registry sentence to source/search.html.
evidence_items.learned: The seed issue has an explicit source-history application matching the current text.

evidence_items.summary: Related commits added missing common Resource search parameters and later restored missing R5 definitions for _has, _filter, and _in.
evidence_items.learned: Current common search parameter definitions include related later corrections and do not leave a FHIR-36879 source gap.

evidence_items.summary: The discussion records the original missing-definition concern, later confirmation of added common parameters, and Grahame's explanation that result parameters were not formally defined and should be represented by code only.
evidence_items.learned: Community context supports leaving result/HTTP controls out of the SearchParameter registry.

evidence_items.summary: Minutes record FHIR-34332 as duplicate of FHIR-36879 and FHIR-36879 as Persuasive with Modification, 18-0-1.
evidence_items.learned: The duplicate relationship and final vote match the Jira disposition used for this audit.

evidence_items.command: for code in _sort _count _include _revinclude _summary _total _elements _contained _containedType; do rg -q '<code value="'$code'"' source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml source/searchparameter || true; done; rg '<code value="_query"|<code value="_filter"' source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml source/searchparameter
evidence_items.summary: Result-control parameters were absent as SearchParameter definitions, while _query and _filter were present.
evidence_items.learned: The current source implements the intended distinction between formal SearchParameters and result/HTTP controls.
